description: Guess 60+ movies from emoji clues — with letter-reveal hints and streak scoring.

faqs.a: Over 60 emoji puzzles covering classics, animation, action, and horror films.
Each Hint reveals one hidden letter. More hints mean fewer points for that movie.
Type the movie title — matching ignores case and punctuation, so close spellings count.
faqs.q: How exact must my guess be?

faqs.a: 10 points minus 2 per hint used, with a 2-point minimum. Streaks add excitement — keep guessing!

howto: Look at the emoji clue and guess the movie.
Type your guess and press Enter.
Stuck? Press Hint to reveal letters (fewer points).
title: Emoji Movie Guessing Game
